# The Women’s Collective

> A community for women building businesses, careers, creative work, and real relationships close to home in North Brooklyn and Queens. Find your people, share what you do, and help someone else shine.

The collective is for women in North Brooklyn and Queens who are building something — a business, a career, a creative practice. Founders, freelancers, makers, and the newly curious are all welcome. Neighborhoods: In North Brooklyn: Greenpoint, Williamsburg and Bushwick. In Queens: Long Island City, Astoria, Sunnyside, Woodside, Jackson Heights, Elmhurst, East Elmhurst, Forest Hills and Rego Park. Surrounding neighborhoods are welcome too.

Membership is by application, and a real person reads every one. Approval brings a catalogue number, the chance to save a seat at member events, and the choice to show a card in the member directory. Events include coffee introductions, supper clubs and headshot days. The collective does not sell access to its members; partners host, teach, supply or support events.

The founder is Nataša Tuohy, a New York–based architectural and interior designer with a studio in Greenpoint.
